summary.text:
# 堕落帝国特工暗杀统治者！ / Fallen Empire agents assassinate the ruler!

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany

## 如何开始 How it starts

输掉与堕落帝国（非机器）的战争时（on_war_lost，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3162），战败方的统治者被堕落帝国特工暗杀；条件：对方是堕落帝国、非机器，我方非集群意识且有统治者。

When we lose a war against a (non-machine) fallen empire (on_war_lost, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3162) its agents assassinate our ruler; conditions: the winner is a fallen empire that is not a machine, we are not a gestalt and have a ruler.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口 fallen_empires.2：统治者被杀（立即 kill_leader），唯一选项“我们战败受辱，但会再度崛起”。图片随对方是否蜂巢而变。

A single window fallen_empires.2: the ruler is killed immediately; the only option accepts defeat and humiliation. The picture depends on whether the winner is a hive.
